hungary-2013.notes: Source 1 is the SZTE (Szeged) local-round archive page with sections ACM 2014 to ACM 2025 (2014 edition: 17 October 2014, Irinyi room 224); no 2013 edition is on it. The Szeged local round may not be the same contest as the CMS's 'Hungarian ACM Programming Contest' (hungary-2014 is dated 2014-10-19 at a virtual site). This contest is left with no usable copy. The ELTE site captured for hungary-2014 (people.inf.elte.hu/bzsr/acm/) holds the 2013 problem set acm2013.pdf and a link to the 2013 results; that is likely the right source for this contest.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw the institute's homepage; our copy has since been replaced by the actual previous-contests page, which is a real document but covers the Szeged local round from 2014 on, not this 2013 edition.
sources.evidence: The page 'Korábbi versenyek' (previous contests) of the University of Szeged's Institute of Informatics holds the results and announcements of its local ACM programming contest for 2014 to 2025 only, the earliest held on 17 October 2014; nothing on it is about a 2013 contest.

hungary-2014.notes: The site also holds the 2013 problem set (acm2013.pdf, 19 pages) and links the 2013 results on uHunt; these could be sources for hungary-2013, which has no usable copy. The contest is held on the UVa online judge, which may explain the CMS's virtual site location.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw an unrelated ELTE page of course exercises; our copy has since been replaced by the contest site as of 18 October 2014, which is this edition's website.
sources.evidence: The main page is headed 'ACM programozási verseny 2014.' and gives the national round as held at Lovarda on 19 October 2014, registered as the ICPC Hungarian contest for 2014.
